what: The cloud placement node's request models (omnimarket.models.cloud_session_placement, OMN-22243 at omnimarket dev 91fa0fa9). The remote-lane runner's cloud tests validate every request the runner builds against ModelCloudSessionPlacementRequest from these files, so a request shape the live node refuses (the bare host names the pick request once carried) fails here and not on a real cloud start. Pydantic only; CI fetches exactly these paths at this commit.
